description: Dedicated full-route resolvers for official Google traffic. These routes are intentionally separate from the general AI Smart DNS pool used for ChatGPT and Gemini. Clients should prefer DoH/DoT and keep UDP/53 only as legacy fallback.

routes.name: EuroDNS NL · DoH
routes.notes: Encrypted Google Full route over HTTPS/443. The EuroDNS resolver maps selected Google hosts to its EU transparent SNI proxy; client TLS to Google remains end-to-end.

routes.name: EuroDNS NL · DoT
routes.notes: Encrypted Google Full route over TLS/853. bootstrap_ip avoids dependence on the current system resolver while SNI/certificate validation still uses the resolver hostname.

routes.name: EuroDNS NL · UDP legacy
routes.notes: Legacy compatibility route. New clients rank encrypted transports above it and use this only when they actually pass live probes.
